---
title: Authors on tracked changes
format: docx
---

Inline marks carry author and date:
[++ inserted]{author="Gina" date="2026-06-06T06:06:06Z"}
[-- deleted]{author="Hal"}.
A comment[>> from Ivy]{author="Ivy"} too.

Block marks carry them too:

::: ++ {author="Eve" date="2026-05-05T05:05:05Z"}
A block insertion.
:::

::: -- {author="Frank"}
A block deletion.
:::
